Join Our Dedicated Team of Valve Engineering Professionals

A Rewarding Career in an Innovative & Dynamic Organization

Bellator Engineers India Private Limited is a renowned company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and supply of Damper Valves across various segments. With a strong presence in industries such as nuclear power, Oil & Gas, metals & minerals, cement, and more, we are committed to delivering top-notch products and solutions to meet our clients’ diverse needs.

If you are passionate about engineering, possess expertise in Damper Valve design and manufacturing, and seek a rewarding career in an innovative and dynamic organization, Bellator Engineers India Private Limited is the perfect place for you.

Join our team of dedicated professionals and contribute to our mission of delivering excellence in the field of Damper Valves across various industry segments. We look forward to welcoming you to our team, where your skills and talents will be valued, and you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact in the industry.

✓

Diverse Global Industries

Valves serving nuclear containment, offshore marine, thermal power, and major cement conglomerates worldwide.

✓

Culture & Professional Growth

Why Build Your Career at Bellator Engineers?

We foster an environment where technical discipline, manufacturing safety, and individual initiative drive global success.

Advanced Heavy Infrastructure

Direct hands-on fabrication, CNC boring & turning, automatic submerged arc welding rigs, and proprietary hydrostatic test stations.

FEA & CFD Simulation Labs

Computational analysis in action: perform finite element stress verification, fluid flow dynamics, and thermal expansion modeling.

Safety & Zero Compromise

Governed by ASME Sec IX & ASNT standards with uncompromised factory floor PPE, lifting protocols, and clean air systems.

Competitive Packages & Growth

Transparent annual increments, performance bonuses, PF, gratuity, and comprehensive family medical insurance coverage.

Direct Leadership Mentorship

Learn from valve veterans: work closely with domain stalwarts to build recognized authority in industrial flow control.

Global Industrial Impact

Deployed across 20+ countries: take pride in building critical valves operating in thermal boilers, nuclear plants, and marine vessels.

Design & Engineering High Priority

Design Engineer (Damper Valves • 3D Modeling & FEA Verification)

Our 4-Step Engineering Hiring Process

We value your professional time. Our recruitment journey is straightforward, technically focused, and connects you directly with the team.

01 Stage 1

Application & Profile Review

Submit your CV online. Our engineering team reviews your domain background against required valve design, manufacturing, or commercial competencies within 48 hours.
